data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 net technical result of GBP 24.0m (2014: GBP 48.6m) includes GBP 29.0m (2014: GBP 27.7m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 571.241m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded a gross prior year development release of GBP 17.336m (3.0% of opening reserves) driven by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries; the report also notes a net release of GBP 29.0m after reinsurance. Exchange rate movements materially increased the gross balance during the year.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 29.0m (2014: GBP 27.7m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
Effect of movements in exchange rates

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and gross prior year movement are taken from the Balance Sheet (prior year comparative) and the Technical Provisions note respectively (both explicit). The narrative also reports a NET release (GBP 29.0m) which differs from the gross movement (gross release GBP 17.336m) because reinsurers' share increased; both figures are retained (gross used as required). Claims development triangle is present and was used only as a cross-check. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years are identified in the accessible pages.
